name: baton
description: Run, hot-reload, screenshot and debug Flutter, web, React Native and native iOS/Android apps from Codex, through Baton's MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Run, hot-reload and screenshot your apps
interface.longDescription: Baton runs your Flutter, web, React Native and native iOS/Android apps, hot-reloads them after each edit, and hands back logs, failed requests and a screenshot so Codex can see what changed.
defaultPrompt: Run this app on the iPhone simulator and show me a screenshot
Hot-reload my change and tell me if anything broke
Boot an iPad simulator and run the app there too
